name: hex7_async_20deg_4200
description: hex7_async_20deg (orbits/data/acquisitions) with 4200 frames per role: with the 32 bands spread over the whole detector (about 3072 rows, the default band layout on a scene covering the frame) about 1000 to 1080 ground lines are seen by every band, the ground advancing about 0.98 to 0.99 rows per frame at the nominal frame period.
